svg.text: Each track becomes a point. Points that sit close together sound alike, so building a playlist is just picking a way to move between them.
about 80 numbers per track, in these groups
Four ways to move through it, from the generate panel
The tracks closest to the one
A smooth route from track A
Starts from a track and heads
The sliders under “tune the space” change how much tempo, key, mood and so on count towards “close”, and the lists update as you drag.
